# Parity fixtures

`foundation.json` and `manifest.json` are copies of `tools/parity/fixtures/` in
[oito2_ui](https://github.com/oito2/oito2_ui), the source of truth of the rules
this crate implements. They are compared with `oito2_ui@main` by the weekly
`Parity` workflow and must only be updated by copying both files again.
